subject.title: improve(qa): align Telegram proof and remove execution profiles

question: Do maintainers accept runner-owned curated scenario lists and the named `smoke-ci` pack as the permanent replacement for declarative `execution.profiles` in QA scenario YAML?
rationale: The PR states that this architecture direction was chosen, but the protected maintainer label and the move of CI selection authority across several runners warrant an explicit human acceptance before landing.

options.title: Accept runner-owned selection
options.body: Merge after exact-head CI completes, treating the explicit runner lists and exact-membership tests as the maintained QA selection contract.

options.title: Keep declarative membership
options.body: Request a narrower revision that retains YAML-owned profile membership if maintainers want scenario data, rather than runners, to remain the authoritative selector.

recommendation.title: Accept runner-owned selection
recommendation.body: Merge after exact-head CI completes, treating the explicit runner lists and exact-membership tests as the maintained QA selection contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Best available routing candidate from the supplied QA investigation and branch history; final architecture acceptance remains a human repository decision.
